claims: The 130th Boston Marathon is scheduled for Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon is on Patriots' Day.
The 130th Boston Marathon is managed by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.).
The 130th Boston Marathon has a cut-off time of 4 minutes and 34 seconds (4:34).
24,362 runners were accepted from 33,249 applicants for the 130th Boston Marathon.
Applicants for the 130th Boston Marathon had to run 4:34 faster than their age-standard qualifying time.
The Men's Wheelchair division of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 9:02 a.m. ET.
The Women's Wheelchair division of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 9:05 a.m. ET.
The Professional Men of the 130th Boston Marathon start at 9:37 a.m. ET.
The Professional Women of the 130th Boston Marathon start at 9:45 a.m. ET.
The rolling start of the 130th Boston Marathon begins at 10:00 a.m. ET.
The course of the 130th Boston Marathon is the traditional 26.2-mile course from Hopkinton to Boston's Copley Square.
The 130th Boston Marathon is presented by Bank of America.
Road closures for the 130th Boston Marathon begin as early as 8:00 a.m. along the entire length of the course.
Road closures for the 130th Boston Marathon particularly impact Beacon Street
